title: 2013 AMC 10A Problem 5
statement: Tom, Dorothy, and Sammy went on a vacation and agreed to split the costs evenly. During their trip Tom paid \(\$105,\) Dorothy paid \(\$125,\) and Sammy paid \(\$175.\) In order to share costs equally, Tom gave Sammy \(t\) dollars, and Dorothy gave Sammy \(d\) dollars. What is \(t-d?\)

solutions.text:
The total cost was \(\$105+\$125+\$175=\$405\), so each person’s share was \(\$405\div3=\$135\).

Tom paid \(\$30\) less than his share, and Dorothy paid \(\$10\) less than her share, so \(t=30\) and \(d=10\).

Therefore \(t-d=30-10=20\).

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: First find the total trip cost and each person’s fair share
Tom and Dorothy each pay Sammy the amount they are short of a fair share
